notes.title: Global Update 2.3.0
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players.
Important news!
The game will be updated soon, namely: The game will be completely redesigned and written from 0, you will get a fully stable version with new interesting elements and new graphics! 
We apologize to anyone who may have been disappointed in us, we ask you to give us a chance to fix everything! 
Sincerely, the Phantom Studio team.

notes.title: Updating and optimization
notes.notes:
The game received a complete reworking of the texture quality, among other things, serious optimization was carried out, according to the test results, the FPS increase was about-110% (90-150 frames per second)
We also added a mouse speed setting.
A new room has been added, it will be functional in the future. 
We have fixed some errors and shortcomings.
Many other parts have also been redesigned

notes.title: Optimization and sound
notes.notes:
The game was optimized, FPS drawdowns were noticed, this was especially noticeable with the onset of night, this problem was associated with shadows that were loaded in real time.
Now there is a radio in the recreation area, when you use it, you can turn off or turn on the music.
The indicators for meeting the "Needs" have been redesigned.

notes.title: The game is scheduled for release
notes.notes:
The game will go on sale soon, you can buy it and play!
The game is scheduled for release at the end of August, but due to the fact that we have added more content to the game, it is only coming out now!
The game will be available for purchase on 10.10.2021.
